sources.title: qwen3.6-flash model information
sources.evidence: Exact API model page identifies Qwen3.6 Flash as a native vision-language model, lists text/image/video input and text output, function calling, thinking-mode limits and a 1,000,000-token context window. It includes the April 16 snapshot.

sources.title: Model releases and updates
sources.evidence: Beijing release table explicitly dates qwen3.6-flash and qwen3.6-flash-2026-04-16 to April 16, 2026; international and global tables list April 17. These are release listings, not dates inferred from snapshot names.

sources.title: Alibaba Open-sources Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; Wan2.7 Tops Design Arena
sources.evidence: Official April 17 announcement explicitly says the open-weight Qwen3.6-35B-A3B can be accessed through Model Studio under identifier qwen3.6-flash. This supplies an exact alias-to-released-model mapping rather than a family-name inference.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B official model card
sources.evidence: Official weight repository labels the license Apache-2.0. Its Model Overview places nominal 35B total and 3B activated parameters under Language Model, describes a vision encoder and hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated-attention MoE, and lists 8 routed plus 1 shared activated experts.

sources.title: Model inference pricing
sources.evidence: Current documentation explicitly equates qwen3.6-flash with qwen3.6-flash-2026-04-16 and lists both thinking and non-thinking modes. Documentation establishes the alias mapping, not an independently tested running endpoint.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: Agentic Coding Power, Now Open to All
sources.evidence: April 17 release article independently maps Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to qwen3.6-flash and states 35B/3B MoE and released weights. It contains both availability wording and a coming-soon notice, so its publication date alone is not used to establish API launch.

name.note: Readable form of the exact qwen3.6-flash identifier and Qwen3.6 Flash naming on its official page.

developer.note: Alibaba's announcement attributes the mapped released model to Alibaba.

family.note: Qwen3.6 is a generation within the broader Qwen family.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit provider release is Beijing on April 16; other regions followed April 17. Replaces the catalog's April 27. The April 17 blog's mixed availability/coming-soon wording does not supersede the dated regional changelog.

open_weights.note: Explicit API-to-checkpoint mapping establishes available weights; hosting alone is not the basis. This describes the mapped model's weights, not access to deployment-specific serving artifacts.

license.note: License of the explicitly mapped released weights. This is not a claim that the hosted API's service terms are Apache-2.0.

parameters_b.note: Nominal billions for the mapped language decoder only; the card nests 35B under Language Model. Requires proposed language_decoder scope. No whole-checkpoint tensor count is transferred to the hosted deployment.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer's nominal activated language-decoder count in billions, with matching proposed scope; excludes any implied total for vision or serving-specific components.

architecture.note: Mapped model has a vision encoder and a hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated-attention decoder using sparse MoE. The catalog label records its expert architecture.

context_window.note: Exact hosted-model page states 1,000,000 tokens. Its API limit is retained independently of the checkpoint's native/extended context values.

modalities.note: Official capability table lists these input and output modalities for the exact API alias.

reasoning.note: Exact alias and snapshot are listed with thinking and non-thinking modes.

tool_call.note: Exact-model capability table marks function calling supported.

description.value: Alibaba's Qwen3.6 vision-language model for agentic coding and visual reasoning, available through Model Studio as the hosted counterpart of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.
description.note: Uses the documented task focus and explicit checkpoint mapping without comparative performance claims.

patch.description: Alibaba's Qwen3.6 vision-language model for agentic coding and visual reasoning, available through Model Studio as the hosted counterpart of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.
patch.notes: Alibaba explicitly maps qwen3.6-flash to the released Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model; current pricing documentation maps the alias to qwen3.6-flash-2026-04-16. The nominal 35B total and 3B active counts refer only to its language decoder, not a measured total for the hosted multimodal deployment. Apache-2.0 describes the released weights; hosted service terms are separate. Beijing release was April 16, 2026, followed by international/global regions April 17. API operation was not tested.

summary: Corrects first release to April 16, 2026 and recognizes the officially mapped open-weight model. Adds nominal language-decoder counts of 35B total/3B active with component scope, Apache-2.0 weight licensing and MoE architecture. Confirms the hosted alias's 1M context, multimodal input, reasoning and function calling. Deployment-specific tensor totals remain unasserted; documentation was checked, not live inference.
